description: A short celebrity run moves through cycling, steam power, metallurgy, automotive vocabulary and science-fiction cinema, finding quiz-worthy specificity in subjects that range from everyday machinery to fictional spacecraft.

s07e01.description: Peloton turns a compact French-derived word into the episode’s sporting identifier. Cycling terminology joins the wider trivia mix, and something perfectly ordinary to enthusiasts becomes another specialised trap for everybody who merely owns a bicycle.

s07e02.description: The steam locomotive gives the episode a reassuringly mechanical centrepiece. Transport history meets general knowledge on a ladder where pistons and boilers are arguably simpler than the human process of choosing between four almost-plausible answers.

s07e03.description: Stainless steel makes everyday material science unexpectedly quiz-worthy. Chemistry, invention and ordinary life converge around something encountered constantly but rarely considered, which is exactly the sort of neglected knowledge Millionaire enjoys weaponising.

s07e04.description: The humble dipstick gets its improbable starring role. Automotive vocabulary anchors a mixed question set and demonstrates the show’s democratic approach to knowledge: emperors, equations and oily measuring rods are all equally capable of causing trouble.

s07e05.description: Discovery One brings cinematic space travel into the question ladder with impeccable science-fiction pedigree. Film knowledge and broader trivia orbit one another in an episode where remembering a fictional spacecraft can become very real intellectual work.
